candidate_semantics_guard: Existing class_logits are localization foreground/background confidence, not candidate compatibility, and are not used as the trained candidate score.
candidate_source: 10 Moment-DETR decoder slots from exact strict-inner V5 bank rows; each candidate receives original query tokens through one cross-attention layer and a full-query compatibility scorer
controls: max aggregation from identical candidate logits
fresh copied-baseline pre-fusion shuffled-video reforward for both arms
disallowed: No positive candidate mask, no GT seconds-to-slot alignment, no unverified negative mismatch, no grouping parameter search, no formal U tuning.
loss: A0 natural bag BCE only; A2 identical bag BCE plus 0.25 times mean candidate BCE-to-zero on only verified full-query-negative bags
negative_provenance: Every negative train row must carry user_attested_video_review; all 10 complete-query candidates on a reviewed absent video are valid negatives
optimizer: AdamW lr=1e-3 weight decay 1e-4; grad norm clip 1.0
phase: two-fold one-seed strict-inner screen, exploratory Novel-dev
positive_provenance: Human temporal annotation; only bag presence is supervised. No positive-slot labels or GT-window mapping.
secondary_aggregation: max over the same candidate logits; no tuned temperature
selection: inner Seen-val pooled AUROC under primary normalized-LSE aggregation, earliest tie; Novel-dev not read during training
uncertainty: Video-cluster bootstrap for pooled AUROC; connected query-video-component bootstrap for same-query pairs; video-cluster bootstrap for same-video pairs; paired deltas in summary
